title: Plaid stories
description: A customer-story carousel on the pale page: a 48px heading with two round periwinkle-outlined arrow buttons, then a sideways-scrolling row of cards that runs off the right edge, each a 20px-cornered picture, a 30px navy title and a 'read the story' link with a circled arrow. Arrows slide the row one card; hovering a card zooms its picture slightly. A tall quiet gap follows, as in the original.
notes: media slot per card: a customer photo (420×250 on desktop, 250×149 on phones); the original's wave-line canvas under the row is left to a soft fade
